meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Radio Garden: dim or hide suggested station lists, hide share and favourite buttons, local time and station counts.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) and an iPhone UA (390x844) on radio.garden/ after the place drawer rendered (it opened on a default place).

LIVE counts: lists-dim both home 5; lists-hide both home 5; share-favorite phone home 2; desktop home 4; place-meta both home 2. Selectors are structural or aria-based because every class carries a build hash: `article[role="main"] > div > div > section:nth-of-type(n+2)` leaves the first list (Stations in <place>) and drops the later lists; the share and favourite labels are English-only.

Choice: Suggested station lists Show/Dim/Hide (opacity 0.35). Radio Garden serves AdSense (`ins.adsbygoogle`, 2 on the page, display:none and unfilled when seen); the 1.0.0 ad rule already covers it.

NOT verified: the full-screen search, favourites and history pages, the player bar, the globe overlay, the Press play dialog (never hidden), other languages (aria labels follow the UI language).
